text:
Kim R: Quick postmortem follow-up for INC-2078. We keep seeing a recurring burst pattern where KV shard warming fails and operators flush caches, causing cascade cold starts. Need owners for: runbook edits (exact commands), short-term hotpatch (config toggle + rollback steps), and alert/escalation windows.

Arjun P: I'll take the runbook edit. Will add a 'first 5 minutes' checklist with the minimal commands we used yesterday and a non-destructive KV sanity check. ETA 3 business days.

Lena (SRE): I'll own alert tuning and escalation text. Proposal: page oncall-primary if p95 > 2s for 3m; no ack in 4m -> page secondary and DM infra-leads. I'll open INC-2078-ESCL.

QA Sam: I'll add a lightweight staging smoke that simulates a 30s burst and asserts kv_hit_rate >= 90% within 25s. Will attach results to the Jira ticket.

Arjun P: Commands to include (kept minimal):
```
POD=$(kubectl -n inference get po -l app=inference-runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl -n inference logs $POD --since=5m | egrep -i "kv_cache|kv_hit_rate"
kubectl -n inference exec $POD -- curl -fs localhost:9100/metrics | egrep "kv_hit_rate|cold_start_count"
```
Also add safe non-destructive checks before any /admin/kv/flush call.

Lena (SRE): Hotpatch plan: temporary reduce default batch_size to 16 and enable aggressive pre-warm for 15m; rollback: restore batch_size and disable pre-warm if latency normal for 30m. I'll create a PR and link here. ETA 10 days for staging validation.

deploy-bot: Reminder: please update INC-2078 follow-ups in the incident tracker with owners and due dates by 2026-05-10.

Kim R: Action recap so tracker aligns:
- Runbook triage + commands: Arjun P  due 2026-05-05, PR to runbooks repo.
- Alerts & escalation text: Lena (SRE)  ticket INC-2078-ESCL, due 2026-05-03.
- Staging burst smoke + results: QA Sam  due 2026-05-07.
- Hotpatch config + rollback plan: Lena (SRE)  due 2026-05-14.

Arjun P: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/inference/runbooks/pulls/211 (first-5-min checklist + commands). Feedback welcome.

Lena (SRE): Jira: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-2078-ESCL created.

Kim R: Thanks everyone. If anything slips, update this thread and the incident tracker. We'll schedule a 15-min sync after PRs are merged. :white_check_mark:
